title: Disappointed
text: Disappointed. The unit seems to have ample power and performance.  My problem is how difficult it is to line up the tine to the blade for engagement.  When it finally set in, it works fine.  60 years using electric can openers and this one is the first pain in the neck I've owned/used.  I will not purchase again.
